notes.title: Our Survival Collection is growing!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377373/5144945cd373cb412fe39baaac8adae32247de5a.png[/img]

Learn more about our latests project, Serum!

After you woke up, the first thing you’ve noticed was the mysterious plug with a timer on your arm. 
You realise quickly that to survive you will have to find the healing Serum. 

In our game, you’re intoxicated with a deadly virus that is slowly killing your body. The only way to survive is by applying a special serum that will extend your life by only a couple of hours.
You don’t know who and why but you know one thing. Life is in your hands now and your only choice is to race against the time.
Do you have what it takes to reveal the secrets of the mysterious Serum? Find out the truth about its creators and purpose!  

[b]Watch the trailer for our latest game - Serum! [/b]

notes.title: Developement throwback
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373580/4a650261f6af45429e3216e213fcc7170660dbb2.png[/img]

From the very beginning, our goal was to make immersive games that gamers will sink into. Absorbing plot and expressive main character, that’s from where we started. 
In the Day After, Sarah, our main character, is driven by love for her daughter.
Her main goal is to meet her again. Through the game, players will find many clues that will lead them to her in the form of souvenirs from the past scattered around the city. 

On the picture, you will see one of the first concept sketches referring to the plot.

notes.title: Devlog#1: Man's Best Friend
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373580/065eb17fe5e9b9efbbcf29cff9395ad7e06cd991.gif[/img]
Welcome to the first devlog for our newest game - The Day After!

In our regular updates, we will try to show you fresh content straight out of the game and the progress of our work as often as possible.
In our first devlog, we want to introduce to you our favorite and one of the core features of the game. Your only friend and sidekick - THE dog!

Thanks to your furry helper, you will be able to look for side quests, other survivors and scan your surroundings for valuable items that will help you to survive.

If you like what you see and The Day After looks promising to you, share the game page with your friends and write what things you would like to see in the final version of our game - we are always open for conversation!
